Definition
[Ricci potential] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0125 1. Definition 5.11\group normalized-ricci-flow

A metric $g(t)$ on a surface $\M ^2$ is said to admit a Ricci potential $f$ if \[ \Delta f=R-r. \]
